description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2920014817812 SWITCH,ENGINE START: Line 0001 Qty 2 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
